features.matchText: Employer Contributions The Plan does not provide for employer matching contributions or profit-sharing contributions.
features.vestingText: Vesting Participants are always 100% vested in their contributions and any qualified nonelective employer contributions, plus actual earnings thereon.
features.rothText: Participant Contributions Each payroll period, participants may contribute pre-tax deferral amounts as well as after-tax amounts designated as “Roth” contributions up to 90% of their eligible compensation, subject to limitations imposed by the Internal Revenue Code (“IRC”).
features.noEmployerText: Employer Contributions The Plan does not provide for employer matching contributions or profit-sharing contributions.
features.eligibilityText: Eligibility Employees are eligible to participant in the Plan if they are at least 21 years of age and have completed six consecutive months of employment.
features.loansText: Participants may borrow against their accounts a minimum of $1,000 up to a maximum generally equal to the lesser of $50,000, or 50% of their vested account balance.
features.autoEnrollText: The Plan has adopted an automatic enrollment feature such that all eligible participants (except those who affirmatively elect to not participate or who elect a lesser specific contribution percentage) will be automatically enrolled in the Plan with a pre-tax deferral percentage of 5%.
